title: NBN POI 2MYF (Mayfield) - Permanent cable repair
current_summary: Planned works will affect NBN services delivered via the Mayfield (2MYF) POI. An upstream provider will perform a permanent cable repair between 12:00 AM and 7:00 AM AEST on Monday 7 September 2026. Services via this POI may be interrupted for up to 6 hours during the window. Our team will monitor and provide updates as needed.

updates.content: We will be carrying out scheduled maintenance with an upstream network partner between 12:00 AM and 7:00 AM AEST on Monday 7 September 2026. This is to complete a permanent cable repair. NBN services delivered via the Mayfield (POI 2MYF) Point of Interconnect may experience interruptions during this window, for up to 6 hours in total. Our team will monitor the works and update this notice if anything changes. We appreciate your patience.
